top_signals.title: Trillions are being ‘wasted’ on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He’s betting on what comes next
top_signals.summary: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes says the AI infrastructure boom is being overbuilt and is betting an eventual crash and bailout will send crypto higher.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
